answer: Because the terrace cluster is derived from funding history, the split is applied at settlement and the crystal audit lists each share. That makes each additional alias in a cluster strictly dilutive, so the operator pays the bond and the grove fee for a smaller payout than one honest position would earn. The reward pool is divided per detected cluster rather than per key, so 182 linked identities split one share instead of collecting 182 of them. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
